headline: Casio G-SHOCK GAC-2500-3A (Nov 2026, $145 reported)
stop_reason: Research step fails validation: job and project IDs do not match, and the start URL (https://rolex.com/newsroom) was never opened so it cannot be recorded as opened. Casio pages were blocked (403) so the release price relies on a dealer listing (Teddy Baldassarre, checked 21 Nov 2026) and G-Central; a permitted product photo was obtained from the dealer page and credited Casio G-Shock. Slides, hook, carousel and caption have not been written yet. Fix: rerun start with the correct ID and the actual source URL, then continue from step 2.
